Name: Furn-Nificient
Author: Vechio
Description:
[size=5][b]About[/b][/size]
One of most boring things in my opinion is to spend hours making a lot of furnaces to get a nice bunch of ingots, well no more.
I and and Molenfeuer present this Industyrial Furnace, you can put all your ingots and everything will be ready the next day!

[u]Looking for different skins? Check out this amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24637?tab=description]Furn-Nificient Retexture[/url]![/u]

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
Buy the furnace [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop]on Robin's[/url] and put in your farm, it takes two days to complete, after that you can use how many times you want.

[size=5][b]Compatibility List:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools[/url]

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
My special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Molenfeuer/mods]Molenfeuer[/url] for the animation, and the main code of the mod.
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/WanNe777/about-me?gameId=1303]WaNne777[/url] by making such a incredible texture to the mod!
And finally, thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/iargue/about-me?gameId=1303]iague[/url] for letting me make the mod compatible with the Prismatic Ore as well.


[size=1]I appreciate feedbacks to help to improve something.[/size]
